title: Paul Meets Jesus on the Road
reflectionQuestion: Jesus met Saul with love, and Saul's whole heart changed. Who is someone you would like to show God's love to?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Early Church, secondary/short-only). A brand-new character (Saul/Paul) + the TRANSFORMATION register -- God can change and love anyone. Saul's persecution is SOFTENED to 'did not like Jesus' friends and wanted to stop them' -- no arrests, no violence; the only conflict-word is Jesus' own gentle 'why are you trying to hurt me?'. Indelible image = the bright light on the road + the voice from heaven. The 3 days blind + kind Ananias kept simple. Lands on the change of heart + a life of telling everyone God loves them. 'God'/'Jesus' throughout, no Yahweh. VOICE_BRADFORD (passionate conviction) -- fits the dramatic conversion; rests the over-used voices.
